label: 咖啡对谈
description: V5 写实模板：咖啡对谈（白天咖啡馆对谈，风格 film_interview）

acts.name: 第 1 幕
acts.visual: Morning light through a cafe window, dust motes in the air, a wooden table with two cups of coffee, the camera slowly pushes in from the window.

acts.name: 第 2 幕
acts.text: 上午的咖啡馆最适合聊天，光刚好，人也刚好。
acts.visual: Medium shot of a 38-year-old Chinese man in a dark coat sitting by the cafe window, warm daylight on his face, he speaks to camera while a cup of coffee steams on the wooden table.

acts.name: 第 3 幕
acts.text: 开店五年，最常听见的一句话就是：再坐一会儿。
acts.visual: A 32-year-old Chinese woman with long hair in a sage shirt stands behind the cafe counter pouring a hand-drip coffee, warm pendant light above, she looks up and speaks to camera.

acts.name: 第 4 幕
acts.visual: A barista pulls an espresso shot behind a wooden counter, steam rises, warm pendant lights over the bar, the camera glides along the counter past cups and coffee beans.

acts.name: 第 5 幕
acts.text: 每周来三次，一杯手冲坐一下午，比开会管用。
acts.visual: A 45-year-old Chinese man with glasses and a goatee sits on an old cafe sofa, holding a coffee cup, afternoon light from the side, he speaks to camera with a relaxed laugh.

acts.name: 第 6 幕
acts.text: 咖啡不解决问题，它只是让人有勇气再想一遍。
acts.visual: Medium-close shot of the host at the cafe window, coffee cup in hand, soft daylight and blurred street outside; he speaks calmly to camera, then looks out of the window.

scenes.label: 咖啡馆窗边座位
scenes.description: 真实咖啡馆窗边：木桌、咖啡杯、窗外的街与树影、上午斜射的自然光，安静适合聊天。

scenes.label: 咖啡馆吧台
scenes.description: 真实咖啡馆吧台：木吧台、咖啡机、吊灯、蒸汽、背后摆满豆罐与杯子，适合手冲与 B-roll。

scenes.label: 咖啡馆沙发角
scenes.description: 真实咖啡馆沙发角：旧沙发、矮桌、暖灯、绿植，适合长时间对谈。

closing_broll.visual: Final wide shot of the cafe corner in golden afternoon light: two empty cups, a hand turning a page, dust motes drifting, the camera slowly pulls back.

meta.note: 白天咖啡馆对谈：窗边木桌 / 吧台 / 暖光
